integrity: Exact integer spectral and trace certificates; independent orbit enumeration and modular ranks as additional corroboration.
scientific_limitations: Only the 840 labelled order-nine Steiner triple systems and degrees at most three. The full Gram eigenvalues are for membership monomials, while Walsh characters have the same ranks but different Gram values. Griggs–Rosa 2003 uniformly intersecting systems chapter inspected only at abstract level; unindexed exact spectra remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Cubic Walsh recovery and the exact incidence-sampling spectrum of labelled affine planes of order three
